description: Current Craigslist listings for one site and category (e.g. sfbay + cta = cars & trucks, newyork + apa = apartments), optionally matching a search query: title, price, area and listing URL, newest first as Craigslist orders them, read from the public search page. Up to ~300 results per call; no contact details or full post text. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

category.description: Category code, e.g. sss (all for sale), cta (cars+trucks), apa (apartments), jjj (jobs), bik (bikes). Default sss

site.description: Craigslist site subdomain, e.g. sfbay, newyork, losangeles, london (required)

name: travel_craigslist
title: Travel Craigslist
